blocks.html:
The search for an internship or job is an individual activity in which the student commits to finding a work opportunity (sector / role) relevant to their study programme.

Before starting the search, it is advisable to prepare an effective application portfolio.

The USI Career Service offers several tools to support you in your search:

  • Job Bank – the official platform with internship and job offers.
  • Career Newsletter – weekly updates with news and new opportunities.
  • Career & CV Counselling – book an individual appointment.
  • Career Events – opportunities to meet companies and recruiters.
  • Career Stories - career testimonials from USI alumni
  • Internship Stories - internship experiences from USI students
  • Useful Links – helpful resources for your career and job search.

items.title: Summer Internships
items.html:
A Summer Internship is a short-term internship held during the summer months and it is mainly intended for students who are still in education.
It offers an opportunity to gain first practical experience in a company over a short period, usually aligned with the academic break.

Some companies that offer this type of program:

Company Duration Typical period
ABB 2-3 months June - August
Bloomberg 2-3 months June - August
Google 3 months May - August
Guess 2-3 months June - August
Microsoft 2-3 months May - August
Nestlé 1-3 months July - September
Novartis 3 months June - August
Roche 3 months July - September
UBS 2-3 months June - August

Note:

This list is not exhaustive. Program periods and durations are subject to change. Students are advised to consult the official pages of the respective companies for up-to-date information.

items.title: Internship Programmes
items.html:
An Internship Programme is a structured internship that can take place at different times of the year.
It often lasts 6–12 months and allows students to deepen their knowledge of a specific professional field through a continuous hands-on experience.

items.title: Graduate Programme
items.html:
A Graduate Programme is an entry route for recent graduates, designed to support the start of their professional career within a company.
It is a structured programme that includes training, mentoring, and rotations across different teams and functions.
